_comment: Central configuration for the interview bot. Edit this file to change any interview parameters.
_comment_mode: Interview mode: 'manual' (instructor-specified required questions), 'submission' (probe the student's own uploaded work), or 'knowledge_base' (formative check against instructor-provided course content). If omitted, the mode is inferred: 'submission' when student_submission is non-empty, otherwise 'manual'.

Core Process: Inputs and Outputs.description: Student correctly explains the purpose of photosynthesis and identifies the inputs (carbon dioxide, water, light energy) and outputs (glucose, oxygen), ideally referencing the overall balanced equation.

Two Stages: Light-Dependent Reactions an.description: Student distinguishes the light-dependent reactions (in the thylakoid membranes, producing ATP and NADPH) from the light-independent Calvin cycle (in the stroma, fixing CO2 into glucose) and explains how they are linked.

Role of Pigments and Light Capture.description: Student explains how chlorophyll and accessory pigments absorb light, why plants appear green, and how absorbed light energy is used to excite electrons.

Limiting Factors and Rate.description: Student discusses how light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration, and temperature affect the rate of photosynthesis, including the concept of a limiting factor.

Connection to Respiration and the Carbon.description: Student relates photosynthesis to cellular respiration and the wider carbon cycle, showing how the two processes are complementary.

interview._comment_warning: Warn the interviewee when this many seconds remain. Set to 0 to disable.

_comment_student_submission: The student's actual submitted work, as plain text. Leave empty for the default content-knowledge interview that mirrors the questions below. Provide a value to switch the bot into submission-focused mode, where it probes the student's understanding of what they submitted and treats the questions as areas of focus.
_comment_knowledge_base: Instructor-provided course content (required readings/notes), as plain text. Used in 'knowledge_base' mode: a lightweight formative check of whether the student engaged with and understood the material. The questions below are treated as lines of questioning / areas of focus over this content. Leave empty when not using knowledge_base mode.

questions.text: Ask the student to explain the overall purpose of photosynthesis, including the main inputs and outputs and, if they can, the overall balanced equation.

Prompt the student to describe the two main stages of photosynthesis - the light-dependent reactions and the Calvin cycle - including where in the chloroplast each takes place and how they are connected.
Inquire about the role of chlorophyll and other pigments in capturing light energy, why plants appear green, and what happens to the absorbed energy.
Ask the student to discuss the factors that affect the rate of photosynthesis - such as light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration, and temperature - and what is meant by a limiting factor.
Encourage the student to explain how photosynthesis and cellular respiration are interconnected and how photosynthesis fits into the wider carbon cycle.

llm._comment_base_url: null uses the default OpenAI endpoint. Set to a local URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1) for a local model.
llm._comment_api_key: null reads OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment. Set explicitly only for local/alternative providers.

scheduling._comment_student_email: Where the Zoom meeting link will be sent
scheduling._comment_scheduled_start: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset. trigger.py waits until this time before launching the bot.
scheduling._comment_duration_minutes: Zoom meeting duration. Should be longer than interview duration to avoid auto-close.

system_prompt._comment: Optional extra instructions appended to the generated system prompt

audio._comment_stt_model: Whisper model size. Options: tiny.en, base.en, small.en, medium.en (larger = more accurate, slower)
audio._comment_stt_device: Device for Whisper inference. Use 'cuda' if you have an NVIDIA GPU
audio._comment_silence_threshold: RMS energy level below which audio is considered silence. Raise if your mic picks up background noise.
audio._comment_silence_duration: Seconds of silence after speech ends before recording stops
audio._comment_elevenlabs_voice_id: ElevenLabs voice ID (not display name). Find IDs at elevenlabs.io/voice-library or via the API. Current = James - British Professional Smooth
audio._comment_elevenlabs_model: ElevenLabs model. eleven_turbo_v2_5 is fastest; eleven_multilingual_v2 is highest quality.
audio._comment_transcript_provider: recall.ai transcription provider — only used as a fallback. Bot STT uses the raw audio websocket + local Whisper. meeting_captions requires no API key.
